prompt: Build a modular Automated Cloud Infrastructure Provisioner in C# structured into: (1) Declarative Resource Parser reading infrastructure JSON definitions, (2) Dependency Graph Resolver determining creation order via topological sorting, and (3) Execution Engine simulating asynchronous resource deployment.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Parser Score: 0-5 (Evaluates schema validation and resource parsing)
Module 2 Resolver Score: 0-5 (Evaluates topological sort and cycle detection)
Module 3 Execution Score: 0-5 (Evaluates async deployment simulation and error rollback)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates orchestration reliability)
